entries.name: montgomery_mul
entries.claim: DirtyOutOfPlaceMontgomeryModMul(n, w, p) computes target = x*y*2^-n mod p (< p) with the garbage registers as stated, all other wires clean, no phase; for all x, y < p
assumptions: rules of the strict bridge (A1 controlled-And, C1 QROAMCleanAdjoint where used) and the gadget lemma for AND/erase of qoptct
the qoptct ROBDD prover and lift are the unchanged ones of qoptct.verify
Qualtran 0.7.0 with patch kind c (PR 1997 + exact-integer tables) is the program that is proved; the unpatched 0.7.0 is wrong for T_N >= p
the final claim x*y*2^-n mod p with result < p follows from the proved window contracts, the invariant T_i < y + p and the telescoping sum (the last two are checked by code, not by a separate proof)
invariant of the generic window: interval arithmetic where the BDD does not fit in memory (n > 192 or w >= 4)
windows 1..N-1 are the same program with their own wires (equal QASM and layout hash, checked)

entries.name: kaliski_inverse
entries.claim: KaliskiModInverse(n, p): x_out = x^-1 * 2^(2n) mod p for 0 < x < p, 0 for x = 0; all other wires clean; for all x
assumptions: rules of the strict bridge (A1 controlled-And, C1 QROAMCleanAdjoint where used) and the gadget lemma for AND/erase of qoptct
the qoptct ROBDD prover and lift are the unchanged ones of qoptct.verify
the conditions M-carry, M-dbl, M-a, M-s, M-end, M-end-vf are closed by Z3 lemmas for all n, p, x (kaliski_lemmas.json)
p is prime: 2^255-19 and the secp256k1 prime are accepted as known primes without a certificate
the assembly of the program from the real pieces is trusted; it was compared with the full expansion at small n and with an independent simulation
the canary evidence (damaged circuits that must not be proved) is part of the criterion at n = 256

entries.name: pair_montgomery

assumptions: rules of the strict bridge (A1 controlled-And, C1 QROAMCleanAdjoint where used) and the gadget lemma for AND/erase of qoptct
the qoptct ROBDD prover and lift are the unchanged ones of qoptct.verify
the forward block is NOT verified here; its contract is the result montgomery_mul
structural argument: mirror of the forward program up to a renaming of wires; the table blocks are abstracted to LD/CLR (the abstraction is checked block by block)

entries.name: ecadd
entries.claim: ECAdd(n, p, 1) is the point addition in Montgomery form (all special cases), a, b, lam_r unchanged, other wires clean
assumptions: rules of the strict bridge (A1 controlled-And, C1 QROAMCleanAdjoint where used) and the gadget lemma for AND/erase of qoptct
the qoptct ROBDD prover and lift are the unchanged ones of qoptct.verify
the Montgomery multiplier (window 1) and the Kaliski inverse are used as boxes with contracts (ecadd/contracts.py); an instance without a proved contract is reported as ASSUMED in the verdict
the three records of the step formulas (BDD, Z3, integer) agree on sample points only, not by proof
lemmas about the curve (MM0, K0, C1, C2, EC_DBL, EC_TAN, EC_RNOTO, EC_RNOTP) are used in Z3 glue; checked by brute force for p <= 23, not proved for p = 2^255-19
primality of the modulus; Z3 as the solver of the glue
